name: nookdeck
description: Turn any phone into a Stream Deck-style control panel for your computer. Web-based, no app install.

scripts.dev: bun scripts/ensure-icons.ts && bun scripts/ensure-web.ts && bun scripts/gen-assets.ts && bun --watch src/index.ts
scripts.start: bun scripts/ensure-icons.ts && bun scripts/ensure-web.ts && bun scripts/gen-assets.ts && bun src/index.ts
scripts.test: bun scripts/ensure-icons.ts && bun scripts/ensure-web.ts && bun scripts/gen-assets.ts && bun test test
scripts.typecheck: bun scripts/ensure-icons.ts && bun scripts/ensure-web.ts && bun scripts/gen-assets.ts && tsc --noEmit
scripts.build:web: cd web/deck && bun install && bunx --bun vite build && cd ../manage && bun install && bunx --bun vite build
scripts.build: bun scripts/ensure-icons.ts && bun run build:web && bun scripts/build-mediaremote.ts && bun run gen-assets && bun build src/index.ts src/platform/mac-worker.ts --compile --outfile dist/nookdeck && bun scripts/sign-macos.ts dist/nookdeck
scripts.build:win: bun scripts/ensure-icons.ts && bun run build:web && bun run gen-assets && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/nookdeck-windows-x64.exe
